name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.7

  • Adds a subtle Details & sizing chip directly to collapsed product rows.
  • The chip opens the existing product details and size-information modal without expanding the pricing accordion.
  • Uses a low-contrast neutral treatment with navy text, soft gray border, and restrained gold keyboard focus.
  • Keeps the accordion row and details chip as separate native buttons for correct keyboard and pointer behavior.
  • Removes the redundant details link from inside the expanded pricing panel.
  • No pricing, Supplier Sync, cart, artwork, savings, or checkout calculations changed.
